dataSource.label: Data source
dataSource.sdkHelp: Events your app sends with the SDK's track().

sql.help: One row per event with columns <c>user_id</c> {{text}}, <c>timestamp</c> {{time}}, <c>value</c> {{float}} (use 1 to count), in {{warehouse}} SQL. furca joins it to exposures by <c>user_id</c>.

event.label: Event
event.unavailable: Event suggestions are unavailable right now. Type the event name you send with track().
event.suggestions: Suggestions are events received in {{environment}} over the last 30 days. You can also type a name that hasn't arrived yet.
event.none: No events received in {{environment}} yet. Type the name you will send with furca.track("purchase").

aggregation.label: Aggregate
aggregation.sumHelp: Adds up the <c>value</c> passed to <c>track(name, value)</c>, e.g. revenue in cents.

window.label: Window
window.delayHelp: Ignore events in the first hours after exposure, e.g. to skip the visit that triggered it.

form.inverseHelp: For metrics you want to go down, like latency, errors or churn. A decrease then counts as winning.

capping.label: Capping
capping.help: Protects against a single whale: one user with an unusually large total can swing the average. Capping limits each user's total before variations are compared.
capping.absoluteHelp: In the metric's own unit, e.g. 50000 for revenue in cents.
capping.percentileHelp: Computed across all variations at each analysis. 99 is a good default.
